```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This file prepares the **simulated** data for VAR(1) and VARX(1,1) regression. There is no real-data cleaning in the current project. Its main processing step pairs each observation at time t with lagged values from time t−1.

```{r}
source("00_requirements.R")
load("data/simulation_objects.RData")
source("02_funct_MethodImplementation.R")

# Check that simulation objects exist
required_objects <- c(
  "data_VAR_weakDEP", "data_VAR_strongDEP", "data_VARX_weakDEP_weakEXO",
  "A_weak", "A_strong", "B_weak", "Z", "burn_in"
)
missing_objects <- required_objects[!vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1),
                                             inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop("Run the simulation setup first. Missing: ",
       paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "))
}

# Keep the Z observations lined up with retained Y
# The model uses Z[t-1] to predict Y[t]
Z_retained <- Z[(burn_in + 1):length(Z)]
stopifnot(length(Z_retained) == nrow(data_VARX_weakDEP_weakEXO))

# Fit VAR(1) to the two datasets without Z
weak_data <- make_lagged_design(data_VAR_weakDEP)
strong_data <- make_lagged_design(data_VAR_strongDEP)

# Prepare the two VARX specifications for the same simulated dataset
exo_data_as_VAR <- make_lagged_design(data_VARX_weakDEP_weakEXO)
exo_data_as_VARX <- make_lagged_design(data_VARX_weakDEP_weakEXO, Z_retained)

# Organization only: save prepared response/predictor pairs for the analysis files.
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save(weak_data, strong_data, exo_data_as_VAR, exo_data_as_VARX,
     Z_retained, file = "data/processed/lagged_designs.RData")
```
